# EUDF

`ghost_faction_eudf`

2040 EUDF (Woodland): European Defense Force 2035's BLUFOR EUDF set - its men, kit and vehicles, inherited rather than copied, so the mod must be loaded - with FA tier 3 ammunition; its APCs and the RCH 155 are the GTK Boxer (Hawks GTK Boxer) with the German markings covered. Generated by `tools/gen_mod_factions.py`.
